meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会制作 HyperFrames 幻灯片：多张独立页面，支持逐段显现、分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注。产出是可翻页的演示，不是视频；也能把现有网页转成幻灯片。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做幻灯片时直接执行；若只是提到“演示文稿”、“pitch deck”、“deck”等词，Claude 会先说明并询问是否要做成 HyperFrames slideshow，得到同意后才动手。

say.text: 把这份大纲做成一个 HyperFrames 幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会按大纲创建多页可导航的演示。

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片，保留动画和交互。
say.note: Claude 会转换并保留原页面的动态与交互。

say.text: 在第二页加个热点，点击跳到补充材料。
say.note: Claude 会在该页添加可点击的跳转入口。

howto.what_en: Claude authors a HyperFrames slideshow: a deck of discrete slides with fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter notes. Output is a navigable deck, not a video; it can also convert an existing page into a deck.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow. For adjacent requests like 'presentation', 'pitch deck', or 'deck', Claude first explains and asks for confirmation before authoring.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a HyperFrames slideshow.
say_en.note: Claude creates a navigable multi-slide deck from the outline.

say_en.text: Convert this page into a slideshow, keeping animations and interactions.
say_en.note: Claude converts it and preserves motion and interactivity.

say_en.text: Add a hotspot on slide two that jumps to the appendix.
say_en.note: Claude adds a clickable branch entry on that slide.
